subject: Re: Project Palisade kickoff - reverse thinking for small reasoners
body:
Dmitri,

Palisade staffing below:

- Freya Ruiz 50%: method owner - the augmentation stage (forward reasoning, backward questions, backward reasoning) and data quality filters.
- Quentin Farkas 40%: student training + eval across the task suite.
- Giannis Sato 40%: pipeline engineering; he's scripting the augment_data.py flow per task so reruns are one command.

Compute: teacher-side generation is the expensive part - I've budgeted ~$18k of teacher-model inference for the full eight-task augmentation at n=100 (full training data). We'll pilot at n=10 on Date and GSM8K first to validate quality before burning the budget. Student fine-tuning fits on 16 A100s on titan-a100, best effort.

Risk to flag early: teacher generations for MATH look noticeably weaker in the pilot sample; may need a filtered second pass there.

Alina
